    A geometric stable family at a weight defined over the ground field #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_infinite_geometric_stable_family (k F : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] [Infinite F] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (h : ¬IsEFinite R) :
    ∃ (P : TwoTerm R) (d : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (c : GrothendieckGroup (FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R))), (stableClassesOfClass (↑d • TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P) - e • dimensionWeight F) c).Infinite

    A missing ground class gives infinitely many stable modules of one geometric composition class. Their common weight is a ground Euler weight and the regular weight combined with integer coefficients.
